rationale: Identity verification by name and zip was done correctly. However, the agent then made several policy violations and unsupported claims: (1) It asserted the order contained two vacuums (one robotic, one canister) without tool evidence; the visible order data showed only one vacuum item. (2) It proceeded to submit an exchange without first obtaining explicit confirmation of the exact change, which policy requires before any write. (3) The exchange call used item IDs that were not shown in the order or product details and claimed availability/features (canister, bagless, pet-hair version) not supported by the product data shown. (4) It unilaterally set the refund to the original PayPal method before confirming refund preference, and then gave contradictory information regarding issuing the price difference to a gift card (first saying it’s possible, then saying it isn’t without an existing gift card). These issues constitute unsupported statements and improper order-changing actions without confirmation, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
